title: Agentic Harness — Feature State
description: Machine-readable canonical state for a feature workflow. Source of truth for orchestration, resume, and telemetry.

schema_version.description: State-schema version controlling grandfathering per D-7. `v2` = pre-proposal-29 shape: single `current_phase`, no feature-list requirement, no model_choice fields. Features initialized before the mandatory-feature-list / parallel-phases rollout stay at v2 and finalize under their original semantics. `v3` = post-proposal-29 shape: `feature-list.json` is mandatory, `current_phases[]` array is supported for parallel execution, per-entry `model_choice` + `model_choice_rationale` are populated. Initialize-feature always writes the latest version (currently `v3`) for new features; resume-feature reads this field to decide whether to run the feature in grandfathered (v2) mode or strict (v3) mode. A v2 feature never auto-upgrades to v3; migration is an explicit user-requested step, out of scope of this schema.

current_phase.description: Active phase details, null when complete. Used by v2 grandfathered features (single-phase execution). v3 features populate `current_phases[]` instead.

current_phases.description: Active phases for v3 schema features. Supports parallel phase execution per Phase 9 — the array may carry multiple concurrent entries when the orchestrator's parallel-safety check authorises dispatch (see `.claude/commands/agentic-dev.md` §Parallelism Policy). Each entry carries its own `model_choice` and `model_choice_rationale` because parallel phases may dispatch with different models (Phase 10, per-entry per codex v4 important finding). v2 grandfathered features leave this unset and use the singular `current_phase` field instead.

branch.description: Git branch for this phase. Flat naming per D-9: `feature/<feature-name>-phase-<N>`.

worktree_path.description: Worktree path if isolated (required for parallel execution per Phase 9 C-6).

model_choice.description: Per-entry implementation-agent model selected by the orchestrator for this phase dispatch. Populated before every dispatch for v3 features per the 5-rule decision flow in `.claude/commands/agentic-dev.md` §'Model Selection Heuristics'. Per-entry (not top-level singular) because parallel dispatches may carry different models. v2 grandfathered features omit this field.

model_choice_rationale.description: Why the orchestrator landed on `model_choice` for this specific dispatch. The chosen backend may be a Claude model or `codex` (invoked via Codex CLI rather than the Agent tool). Enum values mirror the 8 outcomes of the decision flow in `.claude/commands/agentic-dev.md` §'Model Selection Heuristics': `plan_suggested` (plan manifest's suggested_model passed validation with no promote conditions triggered), five `promoted_*` values (scope ambiguity / unresolved decision / cross-cutting / correctness-critical / foundational, per Phase 10 rule 2), `promoted_fix_round` (auto-promote on fix dispatch per rule 3), and `user_override` (explicit pin via context-doc metadata per rule 4). Recorded before dispatch; telemetry `runs.ndjson` mirrors this alongside duration and token usage so the heuristic can be retroactively evaluated.

budgets.description: Budget limits and escalation policy. Initialized from budgets.json (if present) or defaults.

escalation_policy.description: What to do when budgets are exceeded

project_knowledge.description: Stable facts discovered during implementation that future agents should reuse

last_handoff.description: Context from the last agent run for the next agent. Null before the first implementation/review/fix handoff is recorded.

next_action.description: Exact next action the orchestrator should take
